name: SUP · Supplementary exam
detail_en: You narrowly missed the pass mark and may write again. Confirm by the deadline.
detail_zu: Uphuthelwe kancane amamaki okuphasa futhi ungabhala futhi. Qinisekisa ngaphambi kosuku lokuvala.

name: DEF · Sick (deferred) exam
detail_en: You were ill and handed in a medical certificate. You write on a later date.
detail_zu: Ubugula futhi wafaka isitifiketi sikadokotela. Uzobhala ngolunye usuku.

name: ABS · Absent
detail_en: You did not write and gave no accepted reason. See your faculty office at once.
detail_zu: Awubhalanga futhi awunikanga isizathu esamukelekayo. Bona ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho ngokushesha.

name: NAD · Not admitted to the exam
detail_en: Your semester mark was too low to write. Ask an advisor about repeating the module.
detail_zu: Amamaki akho esemesta abephansi kakhulu ukuthi ubhale. Buza umeluleki ngokuphinda isifundo.

name: OUT · Result outstanding
detail_en: Your mark is not captured yet, or is held back for unpaid fees. Ask before you worry.
detail_zu: Amamaki akho awakafakwa, noma abanjiwe ngenxa yemali yokufunda engakhokhiwe. Buza ngaphambi kokukhathazeka.

name: 1 · Check the requirements
detail_en: Each course lists the subjects and marks it needs. Check before you pay a fee.
detail_zu: Isifundo ngasinye sibala izifundo namamaki esiwadingayo. Hlola ngaphambi kokukhokha imali.

name: 2 · Apply online, yourself
detail_en: Use your own email address and phone number, so the replies come to you.
detail_zu: Sebenzisa ikheli lakho le-imeyili nenombolo yakho yocingo, ukuze izimpendulo zize kuwe.

name: 3 · Upload your documents
detail_en: A certified copy of your ID and your latest school results.
detail_zu: Ikhophi eqinisekisiwe kamazisi wakho nemiphumela yakho yakamuva yesikole.

name: 4 · Keep your reference number
detail_en: Use it to track your application and to answer every message before its deadline.
detail_zu: Yisebenzise ukulandelela isicelo sakho nokuphendula yonke imiyalezo ngaphambi kosuku lwayo lokuvala.

name: Applications open and close
detail_en: Example dates: 1 April to 30 September. Residence applications close earlier.
detail_zu: Izinsuku eziyisibonelo: 1 Ephreli kuya ku-30 Septhemba. Izicelo zezindawo zokuhlala zivalwa ngaphambili.
